assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one polished high-end 3D editorial illustration for an iPhone 3D scanning app campaign. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Bright warm ivory studio atmosphere with confident electric cobalt, cyan light and coral accents, playful energetic premium look, soft realistic materials, clear visual explanation. Recurring main character: friendly young adult woman with short dark bob hair, medium skin, fashionable cobalt utility jacket over white T-shirt, understated silver earrings, holding a recognizable modern iPhone with Dynamic Island. Central composition with all important subjects within middle 75% so can crop for mobile. Phone screen visible where feasible shows clean conceptual scanning UI with tiny simple glyphs only. No letters, no written numbers, no logos, no watermark, no speech bubbles. This is a promotional metaphor, not documentary app screenshot. The woman stands left-center and aims the iPhone at an elegant sculptural coral ceramic vase on a small ivory plinth right-center. A dynamic curved stream of glowing cyan tiny geometric voxels and wireframe fragments travels from the vase toward the phone, where the complete vase appears as a small digital model. The real vase remains intact. Capture motion, a delighted expression, extremely legible subject and phone relation. A few cobalt geometric shapes emphasize depth.
assets.review: Inspected visually: consistent cobalt/coral/cyan palette, clear phone and scan metaphor, no embedded copy, no injury or stereotypes.
